user.title: McCulloch ROB
user.description: Mowers found: {count}. If yours is missing, type its MAC address (you can see it in the ESPHome proxy logs).

pair.title: Pair {address}
pair.description: Power-cycle the mower and submit within 3 minutes (pairing mode). The PIN is the one on the mower keypad; leave it empty if it has none.

reauth_confirm.title: New PIN for {address}
reauth_confirm.description: The mower rejected the saved PIN. Type the current PIN (leave it empty if it has none).

error.cannot_connect: Pairing failed. Reboot the mower and retry; it sometimes needs 2-3 attempts.
error.not_found: No Bluetooth receiver can see the mower right now.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send any protocol command and return the raw response.
